title: Aguero 93:20 — Manchester City win the Premier League with the last kick of the 2011-12 season
body: Final day of the 2011-12 Premier League season, 13 May 2012. Manchester City and Manchester United are level on points; City are top by goal difference. City host already-relegated QPR at the Etihad and need to win to claim their first league title in forty-four years. Pablo Zabaleta gives City the lead in the 39th. Djibril Cisse equalises for QPR after the break. Joey Barton is sent off for QPR but Jamie Mackie heads them in front in the 66th. Forty-four years of waiting and City are losing 2-1 with twenty minutes to go. Edin Dzeko equalises in the 92nd minute from a corner — but it isn't enough; they need three points. Stoppage time, fourth minute. Mario Balotelli, on the floor, gets a leg to a loose ball and feeds Sergio Aguero just outside the QPR box. Aguero takes a touch with his right, drops his shoulder past the defender, and finishes left-footed into the bottom corner. Martin Tyler's commentary — 'AGUEROOOOO!' — becomes the iconic call of the Premier League era. City win 3-2, take the title on goal difference, and end a 44-year wait.
